title: map2d using rectangular view area
shortDescription: A Map2D whose visible tiles are chosen by a fixed rectangle, drawn into the scene by its helpers
description: The same `Map2D` setup as in the camera-based demo, but the visibilitor is a `RectangularVisibilityArea` of 640 × 480 units around the center of the map: what lies inside is drawn, wherever the camera looks. `RectangularVisibilityAreaHelpers` shows the area in the scene, so tiles can be watched appearing and vanishing at its edge while `PanControl2D` scrolls the map with `[W]`, `[A]`, `[S]` and `[D]`. The tiles come from a 2 × 2 debug tileset, repeated by a `RepeatingTilesProvider` and rendered as `TileSprites` through a `Map2DTileRenderer`.
